tools.name: browser.open
tools.label: Open browser page
tools.description: Create a browser session or open a URL in an existing session.
tools.promptSnippet: Open a browser session for web navigation.
promptGuidelines: Use this tool when the user asks you to browse or inspect a website.
Prefer reusing an existing sessionId when continuing the same browsing task.

sessionId.description: Optional existing session id to reuse.

width.description: Optional viewport width in pixels, integer 320-3840.

height.description: Optional viewport height in pixels, integer 240-2160.

userAgent.description: Optional user agent override, at most 512 characters.

tools.name: browser.navigate
tools.label: Navigate browser page
tools.description: Navigate an existing browser session to a new URL.

tools.name: browser.snapshot
tools.label: Snapshot page
tools.description: Read the current page state, text, forms, links, and interactive controls.
tools.promptSnippet: Capture the current browser page to inspect its content and controls.

includeHtml.description: Include raw HTML in the snapshot.

maxItems.description: Maximum controls and links to return, integer 1-200.

tools.name: browser.click
tools.label: Click element
tools.description: Click an element identified by selector or snapshot element id.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element, at most 2000 characters.

elementId.description: Element id from browser.snapshot output, at most 128 characters.

timeoutMs.description: Optional wait timeout in milliseconds, integer 0-30000.

tools.name: browser.type
tools.label: Type into element
tools.description: Fill or type text into an input, textarea, or editable element.

text.description: Text to type, at most 65536 characters.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element, at most 2000 characters.

elementId.description: Element id from browser.snapshot output, at most 128 characters.

tools.name: browser.press
tools.label: Press key
tools.description: Send a keyboard key to the current page or a targeted element.

key.description: Keyboard key, e.g. Enter, Tab, Escape, at most 64 characters.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before pressing, at most 2000 characters.

elementId.description: Optional element id from snapshot output, at most 128 characters.

tools.name: browser.wait
tools.label: Wait for browser condition
tools.description: Wait for time, navigation, or an element to appear.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds, integer 0-30000.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for, at most 2000 characters.

text.description: Optional text to wait for in the page body, at most 2000 characters.

tools.name: browser.close
tools.label: Close browser session
tools.description: Close a browser session and release its resources.
